prompt: A prepared active-learning end snapshot records that data-export ran during the session. The reusable correction is that every new task must detect an already-active recording before selecting task skills. Produce the routing proposal, without editing files.
expected_output: Ownership is resolved from responsibility rather than invocation history. data-export receives no preference, ambiguity is surfaced, and no write occurs before approval.
assertions: the invoked data-export skill is not treated as the automatic owner
the correction is compared against startup and active-learning responsibilities
ambiguous ownership requires user selection
a lesson-owner-change proposal precedes every write

prompt: A prepared end snapshot has one reusable lesson refining an installed release-helper skill. It exists only in a plugin cache, whose manifest identifies https://github.com/example/skills, path skills/release-helper, version commit 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567. No project skill owns release preparation. Produce the disposition only.
expected_output: The cache is discovery-only. Its repository and skill path identify the import source; import-skill freshens and pins that origin before adaptation, and no competing skill is created.
assertions: the plugin cache is not edited
the supplied repository and skill path are resolved before import
import-skill freshens the origin and records its pinned commit
import-skill precedes project adaptation
no differently named competing skill is proposed

prompt: A prepared end snapshot points to ~/.agents/skills/release-helper/SKILL.md as the only plausible owner, but the file has no provenance metadata, is outside Git, and no plugin manifest identifies an origin. Produce the disposition only.
expected_output: The workflow stops and asks the user for an authoritative origin. It neither copies the cache, edits it, nor invents a new competing skill.
assertions: unresolved provenance is an explicit blocker
the user is asked for the authoritative repository or source
the cache is not copied or edited
no competing skill is created

prompt: A prepared end snapshot in the current worktree resolves one lesson to a release skill owned by another repository. Produce the approved-write next step without performing it.
expected_output: The current umbrella checkout is not used for the edit. The recording remains resumable while the user approves a handoff to the owning repository worktree.
assertions: the submodule checkout is not edited
a handoff to the owning repository worktree is required
the active recording remains in end phase until the external update is verified
the handoff occurs only after user approval

prompt: A prepared end snapshot contains one verified, reusable workflow for a new project responsibility. Searches of project, umbrella, managed-repository, user, and plugin skills find no semantic owner. Produce the disposition only.
expected_output: The workflow proposes a new project skill through create-skill, explains its boundary, and waits for explicit user approval before creating anything.
assertions: the absence of an owner is stated with search evidence
create-skill is the proposed disposition
the proposed skill boundary and trigger are shown
explicit user approval is required before creation
no skill is created in the disposition step

prompt: A prepared end snapshot only records the temporary port used by today's test server. There were no corrections, reusable procedures, or repeated recovery patterns. Produce the end disposition.
expected_output: The temporary value is rejected as a one-off fact. No skill changes are proposed, validation has nothing to run, and compare-and-close may finish the recording.
assertions: the temporary port is rejected as a one-off fact
no existing skill is edited
no new skill is proposed
close uses the prepared claim and revision
